messages:
sophia_pm: Heads up — we need a tighter 'onboard acceptance budget' for model catalog entries. Sales wants faster turnarounds but we can't let cost or quality regressions slip. Proposing a small gating spec, opinions?

ezra_eng: +1. Concrete idea: perf econ gate + smokebench + canary traffic. Keep it minimal for first pass.

lin_ml: Quality gate: eval suite pass >= 95% on core prompts; <= 2% hallucination on fact-check tests. Sample size ~1k prompts.

ezra_eng: Perf gate metrics: 99p latency < 450ms (hosted), cost <= $5.00 per 1M tokens on reference workload, p50/p90 targets too. Also error rate < 0.2%.

rachel_cs: Customers are asking for a pin window (90d). Can we offer a 30-day pinned opt-in + migration credits as a compromise?

nate_sales: We can offer migration credits: commit to 3 months credit up to $2k for enterprise moves if bench sign-off is quick. Need legal review for T&Cs.

sophia_pm: Draft gating config (proto):
```
onboard_gates:
  quality:
    eval_pass_pct: 95
    hallucination_max_pct: 2
  perf:
    latency_99p_ms: 450
    cost_per_1m_tokens_usd: 5.00
  reliability:
    error_rate_pct: 0.2
  canary:
    shadow_pct: 5
    ramp_days: 3
```
Thoughts?

lin_ml: cost_per_1m_tokens_usd should be a bucket/range per model class (small/med/large). Also require quantization profile + sample tokenization stats recorded.

ezra_eng: Need explicit rollout/backout plan: automatic fallback to pinned variant + telemetry flags. Also require KV-cache compatibility and memory regression checks.

rachel_cs: Action from CS: draft migration credit template + short comms blurb explaining pin windows. We'll need example FAQ for customers.

nate_sales: I'll own the comms + credit cadence. Can ops produce a short SLI bundle we can share (p50/p90/99 latency + cost estimate)?

sophia_pm: OK — action items: (1) eng/ML finalize bench script + reference workload by Wed, (2) CS/Sales draft credit & comm by Fri, (3) Legal review credit terms. We'll run a 5% canary for 72h then ramp. @ezra_eng can you own the bench script?

ezra_eng: Yep — I'll start a PR with the bench harness and the sample workload. Plan: synthetic + 200 real customer prompts where available.

oncall-bot: incident-bot: FYI — canary job scheduled: catalog-onboard-canary-3479012345 (status: scheduled) :rocket:

sophia_pm: Great. We'll reconvene next Tue for final sign-off. :calendar:
